## Full Content of note-c-courses (Course Structure Documentation)

**Source**: `https://github.com/tutors-sdk/tutors-reference-manual/blob/main/unit-1-getting-started/note-c-courses/note.md`

The note's complete markdown content is as follows:

```markdown
# Course Structure

A Tutors course is a folder of learning resources, named according to the conventions described in this manual.
```

### Minimum Required Files

A course folder must contain exactly three files at the root:

| File name        | Purpose                                         |
|------------------|-------------------------------------------------|
| `course.md`      | Course title + general course information       |
| `course.png`     | Course image                                    |
| `properties.yaml`| Course properties                               |

### course.md format

```markdown
Course Title

Course information - a course outline, description or any other information.
```

### properties.yaml minimum

```yaml
credits: The course author(s) or organisation
```

The `credits` value appears as a subtitle in the course title bar. There are many other optional properties (see note-d-properties below).

---

### Topic (folder prefix: `topic-*`)

Top-level learning resource for a course. Typically encapsulates a session or week of material.

**Two files required** inside a topic folder:

| File        | Purpose                                                                 |
|-------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `topic.md`  | Title + summary. Any filename is allowed, but must be `.md`             |
| `topic.png` | Image for topic card. Filename must match the `.md` file. Can be `.png`, `.jpg`, or `.jpeg` |

**topic.md format**:
```markdown
Simple

Units with presentations, labs + resources
```
First line = title, second line = subtitle.

---

### Unit (folder prefix: `unit-*`)

Groups learning resources under a title. Can appear inside topics or directly in the course root.

**One file required**:

| File      | Purpose                                              |
|-----------|------------------------------------------------------|
| `unit.md` | Title for the unit. Any name allowed, must be `.md`  |

**unit.md format**:
```markdown
Main Lesson
```

---

### Side (folder prefix: `side-*`)

Equivalent to a Unit but rendered in a sidebar.

**One file required**:

| File      | Purpose                                                     |
|-----------|-------------------------------------------------------------|
| `side.md` | Title for the sidebar. Any name allowed, must be `.md`      |

---

### Learning Resources (placed inside unit/side/topic folders)

Folder names encode the resource type via their prefix. All resource types:

| Folder prefix   | Type                                                |
|-----------------|-----------------------------------------------------|
| `topic-*`       | Top-level course topic                              |
| `unit-*`        | Group of learning objects within a topic             |
| `side-*`        | Group of learning objects in a sidebar               |
| `talk-*`        | PDF presentation                                    |
| `book-*`        | Step-by-step lab (markdown) or PDF exercises         |
| `note-*`        | Single web page in markdown                         |
| `tutorial-*`    | Single web page in markdown (different category)     |
| `web-*`         | Link to an external website                         |
| `archive-*`     | Downloadable zip file                               |
| `github-*`      | Link to a GitHub repo                               |
| `panelvideo-*`  | Full-width embedded video                           |
| `paneltalk-*`   | Full-width embedded PDF                             |
| `panelnote-*`   | Full-width embedded markdown note                   |
| `podcast-*`     | Podcast episode (Spotify)                           |

**Naming rules**: No spaces in file/folder names. Append numerals for sort ordering and keywords for meaning (e.g., `topic-01-introduction`, `talk-2-explore`).

**Each resource folder** typically contains:
- `<name>.md` -- title + short summary
- `<name>.png` (or `.jpg`/`.jpeg`/`.gif`) -- card image, filename must match the `.md` file
- Resource-specific files (e.g., `.pdf` for talks, `weburl` for web links, `githubid` for GitHub links, `videoid` for videos, `episode` for podcasts)

**Reserved filenames** at course root:

| File              | Description                    |
|-------------------|--------------------------------|
| `course.md`       | Title for course (mandatory)   |
| `properties.yaml` | Course properties (mandatory)  |
| `course.png`      | Course image                   |
| `calendar.yaml`   | Course calendar                |
| `enrollment.yaml` | Student enrollment file        |
| `weburl`          | Link to external web site      |
| `videoid`         | ID of external video           |
| `githubid`        | Link to GitHub repo            |

---

### properties.yaml Full Options

Key optional properties include:
- `credits` -- course author/org (mandatory)
- `icon` -- SVG icon (alternative to `course.png`), with `type` and `color`
- `parent` -- link to a parent course
- `slack`, `moodle`, `youtube`, `zoom`, `teams` -- companion site links
- `github` -- enables "Edit this page" button
- `ignorepin` -- PIN for instructor-only topic access
- `ignore` -- list of topic folder names to hide
- `hideVideos` -- globally hide all videos
- `auth` -- enable authentication (value `1`)
- `portfolio` -- portfolio mode, no topics (value `true`)
- `labStepsAutoNumber` -- auto-number lab steps (value `true`)
- `private` -- exclude from gallery/catalogue (value `1`)
- `defaultPdfReader` -- `mozilla` or `adobe`
- `pdfOrientation` -- `portrait` for A4 documents
- `llm` -- LLM support level (`0`, `1`, or `2`)
- `companions` -- custom companion icons with link/title/icon

---

**Each resource folder** typically contains:
- `<name>.md` -- title + short summary
- `<name>.png` (or `.jpg`/`.jpeg`/`.gif`) -- card image, filename must match the `.md` file
- Resource-specific files (e.g., `.pdf` for talks, `weburl` for web links, `githubid` for GitHub links, `videoid` for videos, `episode` for podcasts)

**Reserved filenames** at course root:

| File              | Description                    |
|-------------------|--------------------------------|
| `course.md`       | Title for course (mandatory)   |
| `properties.yaml` | Course properties (mandatory)  |
| `course.png`      | Course image                   |
| `calendar.yaml`   | Course calendar                |
| `enrollment.yaml` | Student enrollment file        |
| `weburl`          | Link to external web site      |
| `videoid`         | ID of external video           |
| `githubid`        | Link to GitHub repo            |

---

### properties.yaml Full Options

Key optional properties include:
- `credits` -- course author/org (mandatory)
- `icon` -- SVG icon (alternative to `course.png`), with `type` and `color`
- `parent` -- link to a parent course
- `slack`, `moodle`, `youtube`, `zoom`, `teams` -- companion site links
- `github` -- enables "Edit this page" button
- `ignorepin` -- PIN for instructor-only topic access
- `ignore` -- list of topic folder names to hide
- `hideVideos` -- globally hide all videos
- `auth` -- enable authentication (value `1`)
- `portfolio` -- portfolio mode, no topics (value `true`)
- `labStepsAutoNumber` -- auto-number lab steps (value `true`)
- `private` -- exclude from gallery/catalogue (value `1`)
- `defaultPdfReader` -- `mozilla` or `adobe`
- `pdfOrientation` -- `portrait` for A4 documents
- `llm` -- LLM support level (`0`, `1`, or `2`)
- `companions` -- custom companion icons with link/title/icon
